gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological and/or molecular confirmation of glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients also receive temozolomide PO on days 1-5 every 28 days during radiation therapy.
This phase II trial compares the effect of short course radiotherapy (RT) to standard course RT

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Starting one month post-radiation, patients continue temozolomide on days 1-5 every 28 days for up to 5 adjuvant cycles

role_evidence.quote: Patients also receive temozolomide PO on days 1-5 every 28 days during radiation therapy.
Patients also receive temozolomide PO QD concurrently with radiation therapy and for up to 6 adjuvant cycles
Patients undergo PET/CT with 18-F-DOPA administered IV prior to RT on study

coder_notes: The experimental question is radiotherapy fractionation (short course versus standard course); radiotherapy is not an agent. Temozolomide is given in both arms with a differing schedule (days 1-5 every 28 days with up to 5 adjuvant cycles in Arm A versus daily with up to 6 cycles in Arm B), so by manual rule 3 exception (i) it is coded established_therapy_experiment, not a candidate; a soc_backbone coding would give the same screening result (no candidate). IDH mutation is an exclusion criterion, so IDH-wildtype is effectively required; coded as an IDH eligibility row, not candidate-matched, and cns5. Treatment setting inferred from concurrent chemoradiation with no previous brain RT. Exploratory immune phenotyping is not linked to any candidate, so target engagement is no. Fluorodopa F 18 PET is used for treatment planning/volume delineation.
